name: DBG Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: DBG Technology Co., Ltd. functions as a global provider of electronics manufacturing services (EMS). Its operations encompass the production of mobile and communications network equipment, automation system modules, power inverters, and analytical instruments. Additionally, the company delivers Internet of Things (IoT) and other custom-tailored electronic solutions. Its comprehensive service offering also includes product conceptualization and development, strategic material sourcing, lean production methodologies, and integrated logistics management. The firm serves a wide array of markets, including telecommunications and wireless, automotive, smart building and home technology, energy and industrial applications, and healthcare. Established in 1995, DBG Technology is headquartered in Huizhou, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Guanghong Investment Co., Ltd.
